title: OpenAI’s reported revenue and margin, quarter by quarter in 2026
intro: Move the slider from the first quarter to the third. Each step shows the revenue and, where the report gives it, the growth and the adjusted operating margin for that quarter, as TechCrunch reported them from Bloomberg.
note: All figures are from TechCrunch’s 11 November report citing Bloomberg’s anonymous sources. OpenAI has not published them, and it is a private company. The third-quarter growth is TechCrunch’s own “almost 50%”. No margin was reported for the first quarter. A negative margin means OpenAI spent more running the business than it took in. The $50 billion run rate is Bloomberg’s, and TechCrunch notes OpenAI and Anthropic count partner sales differently.

sources.label: TechCrunch: OpenAI’s quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time, 11 November 2026
